; Hand-written @relation cases, one per line, fed to upstream's comment
; preprocessor + MarkerLexer by tools/upstream-oracle/dump.py and to
; find_relation_annotations by tests/upstream_differential.rs.
; `\n` stands for a line break. Lines starting with `;` are comments.
@relation(REQ-1)
@relation(REQ-1, scope=file)
@relation(REQ-1, scope=class)
@relation(REQ-1, scope=function)
@relation(REQ-1, scope=line)
@relation(REQ-1, scope=range_start)
@relation(REQ-1, scope=range_end)
@relation(REQ-1, REQ-2, REQ-3, scope=function)
@relation(REQ-1, scope=function, role=Implementation)
@relation(REQ-1, scope=function, role=Implements)
@relation(REQ-1, scope=function, role=Verification)
@relation(REQ-1, scope=function, role=Verifies)
@relation(REQ-1, scope=function, role=Test)
@relation(REQ-1, role=Refines)
@relation{REQ-1, scope=function}
@relation{REQ-1, scope=function, role=Test}
@relation( REQ-1, scope=function )
@relation(REQ.1/a_b-2, scope=file)
// @relation(REQ-1, scope=function)
/// @relation(REQ-1, scope=function)
# @relation(REQ-1, scope=function)
## @relation(REQ-1, scope=function)
 * @relation(REQ-1, scope=function)
/** @relation(REQ-1, scope=function) */
some comment\n@relation(REQ-1, scope=function)
/**\n * @relation(REQ-1,\n *   REQ-2, scope=function)\n */
@relation(REQ-1, scope=range_start) @relation(REQ-2, scope=range_end)
@relation(REQ-1, scope=file)\n@relation(REQ-2, scope=line)
see @relation(REQ-1, scope=function) for details
// a marker like ``@relation(REQ-1, scope=function)``
@relation, no braces
@relations(REQ-1, scope=function)
@relation (REQ-1, scope=function)
; Malformed markers: upstream rejects all of these.
@relation(
@relation()
@relation(REQ-1,
@relation(scope=file)
@relation(R, scope=function)
@relation(1REQ, scope=function)
@relation({reqs}, scope=function)
@relation(REQ-1, scope=bogus)
@relation(REQ-1, REQ-1, scope=function)
@relation(REQ-1, role=Verifies, scope=function)
@relation(REQ-1, scope=file, REQ-2)
@relation(REQ-1, foo=bar)
@relation(REQ-1,scope=function)
@relation(REQ-1 , scope=function)
@relation(REQ-1, role=Has-Dash)
; Leaders upstream's generic preprocessor doesn't strip (language readers
; handle them); the crate accepts them. Listed in known-divergences.txt.
//! @relation(REQ-1, scope=function)
-- @relation(REQ-1, scope=function)
<!-- @relation(REQ-1, scope=function) -->
